_comment: THUGPRO compatibility for the THUG1 level ports (tools/thug1_levels). Each entry is registered in README.md here (TP-30 level_names, TP-31 spawns, TP-32 ... TP-39 THUGPRO's other hand edits: moved_nodes, net_presence, created_at_start, node_values, rails, face_values, collision_removed, collision_reshaped - their form: tools/thug1_levels/hand_edits.ts). spawns and TP-32 ... TP-39 are written by `node tools/thug1_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro`, never by hand. Online a level is known only by its load script's checksum (messages 0x46 / 0x33). The other THUG1 levels are named by THUG1's own Levels.qb (Load_NJ...) - THUG1 data, no entry. Read by tools/compat/compat.ts; `thug1_levels.ts convert --compat none` leaves all of it out.

spawns._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx node arrays against THUG1's own, extracted by `node tools/thug1_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro` (pos = THUG2's Pos axes; order: every Multiplayer / Horse / CTF / Team restart in THUGPRO's order, by THUG1's names)

moved_nodes._source: nodes THUGPRO moved: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx node arrays and <level>col.prx collision against THUG1's own, extracted by `node tools/thug1_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro` (thugpro_edits.handEdits; never typed in)
